# Review - PR 539 @ ca866da402947c9ee7e1dd5e935a2782fe0d1602

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Medium-large extraction packet (14 files, +1796/-36): seven new Lean modules, a statement-faithfulness repair renaming three consistency theorems to supplied-witness form, one new source-facing obligation, plus blueprint, paper-gap, audit and telemetry prose.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; blocker) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Construction.lean:67 - This head predates and conflicts with current main, where the same source obligation is already proved: `github/main` 92b252ed carries `exists_pulled_apart_consistency` with a complete proof at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Construction.lean:46` (landed in 6a504509, 2026-09-15), while this head states it with a tracked `sorry`; GitHub reports `mergeable: false` / `mergeable_state: dirty` and a merge-tree dry run conflicts in 8 paths (`MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`, `Extraction/Consistency.lean`, `Extraction/Construction.lean`, `Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean`, `Extraction/PointConsistency.lean`, `Extraction/PointConsistencyPrime.lean`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`). Fix: refresh the branch onto current main and keep only what main does not already contain, or retire this PR as superseded and record the outcome on issue 519.
- [ ] F2 (prose; blocker) blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:220 - The source node `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` here drops `\leanok` and the added gap-note section at `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex:152-201` states that the global-measurement construction and the other two estimates remain open; on current main that node carries `\leanok` on both statement and proof (main lines 223 and 261) against a complete Lean proof, and main's gap note records the composition as discharged. Merging this text as it stands would understate what is proved. Fix: rebase both prose files onto their current main versions and restate only the residual gaps that still exist there.

## Review

Policy read from `github/main` 92b252ed (`local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5, the *Faithful Formalization Policy* in `AGENTS.md`). Scope reviewed: `git diff 17746728..ca866da4`, every changed file read in full; the worktree HEAD equals the published head, so all citations are from the published head.

Prior marked reviews: 5185829644 (approved at b13d6098) and 5194106099 (changes requested at 08ffce99). All four findings of 5194106099 are resolved at this head. F1: the three witness-conditional theorems are renamed `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas_ofGlobalPairWitness`, `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'_ofGlobalPairWitness` and `tildeObs_selfConsistent_ofGlobalPairWitness`, each carrying an `**Unfaithful:**` paragraph naming the missing constructor, and the source blueprint node now links only the new obligation `exists_pulled_apart_consistency` (`Extraction/Construction.lean:46-67`), whose statement puts the universal constants `a, b, C` before all parameters, outputs one `GlobalPairWitness` at `deltaQld`, keeps the zero-error domain, and asserts all three conclusions for that same witness - faithful to paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1463-1480` with the pair supplied by `lem:qld-4-7` (lines 1267-1274); the vacuous `j` in item 1 is dropped as the blueprint comment already records. F2: the docstring of `global_marginal_encoding_consistency` (`Extraction/NonencodingSupport.lean:186-197`) now states the supplied-witness premise and that it constructs nothing. F3: the new audit has the YAML front matter and sections required by `audits/2026-04-29_audit-document-format.md`, and presents a single final-state account. F4: the orphaned PR532 heading is gone; `results/telemetry/events.md` gains two complete incident entries.

Code checks at this head: `rg` over all changed Lean files shows no `axiom`, `admit` or `native_decide`, and `sorry` only at the four pre-existing holes in `Extraction/Consistency.lean` (762, 810, 847, 996) plus the one documented realignment hole in `Extraction/Construction.lean:67`; no new declaration duplicates an existing one at the merge base. I followed the proof of `tildeM_consistent_pointMeas'_ofGlobalPairWitness` (`Extraction/Consistency.lean:873-968`): register regrouping through `sum_marginalPoly_eval_mul`, the decoded-overlap identity from `PointConsistencyPrime.lean`, the reference estimate `deltaG + C*sqrt(epsilon)` from `global_marginal_encoding_consistency`, and the Schwartz-Zippel `md/q` term from `mass_outside_encoding_le_evaluated_defect`; it does not depend on the unfinished `nonencodingMarginalMass_le`, matching its docstring. The conditional blueprint node uses the `example` environment with a `lem:` label, which is the convention main already uses for supplied-witness nodes, and it carries no `\leanok`, so nothing unproved is advertised. Exact-head CI: `local-ci/summary` success ("all gating steps passed (269s)") with build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt and proof-evasion all green; `local-review/summary` is failure only because the code reviewer exited 4 with no review at this head, which this review replaces.

Not checked: I did not run a build or `lake env lean` myself (the exact-head `local-ci/build` covers elaboration and I avoid machine-wide build serialization), did not re-derive axiom closures, did not verify the cost tables in the audit's provenance section, and did not review main's successor commit 6a504509 for its own merits - F1 and F2 rest only on the fact that this head is behind it and conflicts with it.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
